test_title: PYST 23: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held on: 7th November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the letter-cluster from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

DMGU, AJDO, XGAI, ?, RAUA
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a08c777a36f898d492c29ef3a13c1a9aad5b988568e613e5a9282d9466dd8871.png] 

The logic followed here is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d11078b14d63d330263711b2a4c812f05bcada930ffdf58531991f203a21cdf.png] 

U, O, I, E, A → Vowel series.

Hence, '**UDXE**' is the correct answer.
